descriptive_title: Grade 2 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Bar Graphs, Pictographs, and Tally Charts (D1.1-D1.5)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 2 unit on data framed around Detective Dot the Sorting Squirrel and Tally the Tally Cat. Children sort by 2 attributes (Venn/Carroll), use 2-way tally tables, build bar graphs, find modes, and write conclusions.
long_description: Detective Dot and Tally are back! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 2 unit covers all 5 D1 expectations (D1.1-D1.5) building on the Grade 1 unit. Day 1 introduces 2-attribute sorting with Venn and Carroll diagrams. Day 2 introduces 2-way tally tables. Day 3 transitions from pictographs to BAR GRAPHS with title and labels. Day 4 introduces MODE — including bimodal and no-mode cases. Day 5 closes with a Bar Graph Case Capstone integrating all 5 expectations. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-2 trap: overlap trap, double-count, height-mismatch, mode-mistake, personal-not-data conclusion), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite with 5-row summative rubric, and Junior Data Detective G2 certificates.
what_is_included: Unit blueprint with curriculum mapping (1 file)
Manipulatives plan with 12 print-ready assets (1 file)
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 2 teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day data unit (D1.1-D1.5).
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on data investigation with character-driven detective frame. Each lesson follows minds-on / action / consolidation arc with embedded formative checks and expanded walkthroughs.
